pipeline_layers: De-duplicate 1080p inputs back to native 24.000 fps frame cadence (i % 5 != 2) to eliminate 3:2 pulldown stalls.
Solve a bounded-velocity (v >= 0.52x) and acceleration-regularized (lambda_acc = 0.34) L-BFGS-B word-locked time-warp strictly inside [0, L] verified against 0.12s visual mouth-seal boundaries.

Hybrid frame sampling: apply minterpolate fps=60 during held vowels/smiles where v(t) < 1.28x and crisp 24fps sampling where v(t) >= 1.28x, avoiding fast-slow speed swings and spatial mouth patching, plus explicit distant-stage silhouette count anchoring.
